items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: So, Ben and Carl and I said, see, I used to live with Ben.

ctx.x: Could you please me in more details of the person? That was a great day.

I, I, I, I, I, I, Ken Sharp and Fletch. And, uh, when I, um, I came out there, I, I used to play with, I had a higher sense of the orchestra, you know. Fletcher. Fletcher had Dan Rosen, well, all them boys were out of Wilberforce. So, Ben and Carl and I said, see, I used to live with Ben. See, Ben and I used to be just like brothers, see. So, I took the band and carried it all out in the East, you know. And Horace, they made Horace go to school. So, then I, they thought I was Horace since then. That's, that's on…
When you, when you, uh, man. Uh, talking about that, uh, Joe Jordan session, um, would you mind, uh, trying to recall the complete personal?
